title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at The American University in Cairo
official_source: The American University in Cairo (AUC), in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation
duration: Total study period of the degree on full-time enrolment, reviewed every semester for satisfactory academic performance
description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUC is a fully packaged graduate fellowship for African students, starting with the Spring 2027 cohort, under which AUC intends to award fellowships to 300 graduate students in fields that promote African economic development. It targets academically talented young Africans with leadership potential who face the highest economic and social barriers. title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Rwanda (2026/2027 Cohort 5, Undergraduate)
official_source: University of Rwanda, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation
description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program partners with the University of Rwanda to award undergraduate scholarships based on academic merit, demonstrated economic disadvantage and leadership potential.

title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
funding: Monthly stipend, health insurance, and some travel costs
program_type: Government scholarship programme administered by Campus France
duration: Master's: maximum 12 months when enrolling in M2, 24 months for M1, 36 months for an engineering degree. Doctorate: 12 to 36 months starting 1 September of the award year
description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs to help French institutions of higher education attract the best foreign students to Master's and Doctoral degree programmes in priority fields.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship (ESKAS)
degree: PhD/Postdoctoral research and Art Master's only - NOT for standard Bachelor's/Master's study
funding: Monthly stipend, housing grant, health insurance, and travel card
official_source: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI), Switzerland
program_type: Government scholarship (Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students)
duration: Research Fellowship: 6-12 months (no extensions). PhD: 12 months, renewable twice up to 36 months (subject to academic progress). Art Master's: 12 months, extendable up to 21 months depending on programme and ECTS credits. All start 1 September 2027.
description: Each year the Swiss Confederation awards Government Excellence Scholarships to encourage international exchange and research cooperation between Switzerland and over 180 other countries; recipients are selected by the Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS aka ESKAS).

title: DAAD Study Scholarships for STEM Disciplines
program_type: Government-funded Master's scholarship (German Federal Foreign Office, administered by DAAD)
duration: Funding is provided for 10 months to a maximum of 24 months depending on the standard period of study, usually beginning 1 October 2027 or earlier with a prior German language course
description: The programme supports the qualification and employability of young academics from developing and emerging countries by funding a complete, tuition-free STEM Master's degree at a German university.

title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
duration: Three years at $50,000 per year during doctoral studies
description: Named after Major-General Georges P. Vanier, the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships program helps Canadian institutions attract highly qualified doctoral students, and is jointly administered by CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC.
